pkgmetadata.longdescription: Orca is an agentic development environment for desktop, mobile, and headless servers. This package builds the TypeScript/React desktop app and node-pty addon locally with Node.js and pnpm, then packages an unpacked Electron application. A downstream patch keeps the native Linux window frame and disables Orca's renderer-drawn controls, allowing GNOME/Mutter to provide normal window decorations.
